audit_log.value: I own a small gym and need something in writing with a personal trainer who has been using my space, bringing in clients, and paying me casually week to week. It started simple but now there’s confusion about who books sessions, who keeps what money, use of equipment, cleaning after clients, music volume, filming content for social media, and whether they can train clients I already brought in. Sometimes they cancel last minute and still expect access. I also don’t want them representing themselves as an owner or partner. Need something practical and fair that sets schedule access, payment split, responsibility for damage or injuries, client boundaries, and a clean way either side can end it without drama.
